Property Operations Platform

Pre-Submission Claims Review

Products & platforms

Platforms I designed and built

Built to be reused across clients and installed on each client's own data. Screens below use illustrative data.

Product · Education

Growth Control Center for School Operators

Demo built for an education marketing and operations company (name withheld)

One control center for a company that runs marketing and admissions for many schools: every school's position against what was promised, what is late, and what each team member should do today.

Features

  • Portfolio dashboard: every school on one screen, tracked against its committed enrolment target
  • Early warning that flags in month two when a target will be missed, not in the last month
  • Daily priority list for each field employee across all their schools
  • Benchmarks across all schools: response time, conversion and cost per enrolment
  • Unified inbox for every school's conversations, with permissions
  • Contract profitability: revenue per school against staff time and spend
  • Automated client report issued under the operator's own brand
  • WhatsApp agent: ask about any school and get the number and its source
  • Each school's data isolated; only agreed indicators flow up to the center

What it gives the client

  • Protects the margin: problems surface while there is still time to fix them
  • Lets the operator take on more schools without adding staff at the same rate
  • Turns its results across schools into a benchmark no competitor has
  • Gives every client a professional report without manual work

Product · Executive reporting

Smart Executive Report

For owners and boards that are not technical

A report the board can question, not only read. It writes its own summary from the figures, ranks what needs a decision, and every number opens the records behind it.

  • Executive summary written from the data and released only after a named person approves it
  • Alerts ranked by severity, each ending with one action, one owner and one date
  • Anomalies detected without being asked
  • What-if simulation that shows a range and its assumptions, not a promise
  • Ask the report in Arabic or English; it answers from the data and says when it does not know
  • Audit log of every action taken in the report

Product · Assurance

Controls & Compliance Dashboard

Demo built for a financial and governance advisory firm (name withheld)

A policy says a control exists. This dashboard shows whether it is enforced, who owns it, how often it was bypassed, and where the evidence is.

Features

  • Four headline indicators: approved controls, enforcement rate, recorded bypasses, evidence readiness
  • Narrative written from the figures and rewritten with every filter
  • Controls split by where they are enforced: data layer, interface, documented only, undocumented
  • Register of 14 controls with drill-down to the records behind each number
  • Observations with a confidence level and the basis for each
  • What-if simulation with stated assumptions
  • Assistant that answers from the current view and says when it does not know
  • 12-item limitations register, live access log, PDF export and print

What it gives the client

  • The advisory firm shows its client the gap instead of arguing about it
  • Turns a policy manual into evidence an auditor can follow
  • Gives the firm a repeatable, measurable service for every client
  • Clients see progress month by month, in numbers

Assessments, tools & analysis

Proving systems are governed, not just describing them

Frameworks applied: SDAIA AI Ethics Principles, ISO/IEC 42001, Saudi PDPL, EU AI Act, NCA ECC, COBIT 2019.

AI governance tool

AI Compliance Mapper: SDAIA, ISO 42001, PDPL, EU AI Act

Open-source assessment tool

Assesses an AI system against the SDAIA AI Ethics Principles, ISO/IEC 42001, the Saudi PDPL and the EU AI Act, and returns a prioritised risk register instead of a checklist.

  • Decides which controls apply to the system and states the scoping
  • Scores residual risk per control and per framework
  • Lists the evidence an assessor would ask to see
  • First run: an honest self-assessment of my own property AI platform
48applicable controls

AI assurance

AI Release Test Bench

Own project

Fourteen tests an AI assistant must pass before release: accuracy, correct refusal, no fabrication, personal data, permissions and prompt injection.

  • Same tests run on a pipeline without a governance layer and on one with it
  • Release gate blocks on any failure in a zero-tolerance category
